messages:
margo: Quick design review request — proposing a small UX pattern for run history: a compact result badge for tool-calls (success/warn/error) that expands inline to show schema diffs and tool output. Looking for accessibility and copy thoughts before I mock it out.

ana: Love the compact-badge idea for scanability. Quick Q: do we show the schema diff in the expanded view or a link to the full schema editor?

margo: My thought — expanded inline should show a 1-line summary + changeset (if any). Link out to the schema editor for full context. We need clear affordances for keyboard users to expand/collapse.

kevin: UX nit: the current run-history rows already have 3 actions. Adding another affordance could crowd; maybe make the badge itself the affordance (space/enter opens details) so we don't add extra buttons.

sam: From eng POV: making the badge keyboard-focusable and toggling an aria-expanded region is straightforward. We should standardize the badge semantics: green=ok, amber=partial (schema mismatch but fallback succeeded), red=failed.

lee: Accessibility notes: 1) Badge must have a descriptive accessible name (not just color). 2) The expanded content should be in an aria-live polite region if it loads new content asynchronously so screen readers announce it. 3) We should provide a textual link inside the expanded area "Open schema diff" — screen readers need a clear next step.

margo: Agree on names. Draft copy proposals: "Action result: Success", "Action result: Partial — schema mismatch (used fallback)", "Action result: Failed". Thoughts on shortening?

ana: Maybe shorten to prefixed labels for compactness: "Result: Success", "Result: Partial — fallback used", "Result: Error". Keeps the verb "Result" consistent.

kevin: Implementation detail: for partial fallback we should include a small inline pill indicating the fallback model/version used, e.g., "fallback: v2-quant" — that helps debugging. Ensure pill text is clipped with an accessible tooltip.

sam: Tooltip + aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip content works. Also recommend keyboard shortcut to expand next run (e.g., when focused on badge, press Enter to expand; Shift+Enter to open in schema editor). We can instrument events for telemetry.

playground-bot: Deploy preview available at https://staging.redwood/playground/run-history-badges — test account: qa@redwood · pw: demo123 (preview only).

margo: Thanks! I'll check. A couple more UX questions: 1) In compact mode do we hide the full timestamp and only show relative time? 2) When expanded, do we show the JSON schema snippet inline or a diff summary?

ana: For compact mode I'd hide the full timestamp (hover reveals it). For expanded: show a diff summary first (changed fields + types), then a collapsible JSON snippet behind a "Show full schema" control. That keeps cognitive load low.

lee: Also ensure color is not the only indicator — add iconography (check, warning, x) and text label. For voiceover, the badge press should read e.g., "Result: Partial — fallback used. Press Enter to expand details."

sam: Small perf note: loading full JSON for lots of runs can be heavy. Suggest we lazy-load the full snippet only after expansion and show a skeleton in the interim.

kevin: Copy tweak: avoid the word "tool" in the public UI — we use "action" in product language. So label: "Action result" not "Tool result".

margo: Good catch. We'll use "Action". Also thinking about an experiment: default collapsed badges for power users who want dense timelines. Toggle per-user setting in Console.

ana: UI pattern for collapse state: a compact toggle in the run history header "Compact badges" with accessible state. Also remember to persist per-user.

lee: For keyboard users, ensure the toggle's state is reflected with aria-pressed and a visible focus ring. Also test with VoiceOver and NVDA.

sam: I'll add telemetry hooks: expand/collapse, fallback used, and "open in schema editor" clicks. We can use these to evaluate adoption for the experiment.

margo: Final checklist for mock: - Badge visuals (icon + color + label) - Keyboard focus + Enter/Space toggles - aria-expanded + aria-live for expanded content - Diff summary + "Show full schema" button - Fallback pill with tooltip and aria-describedby - Copy: use "Action result" phrasing - Compact-mode header toggle - Lazy-load full JSON snippet.

ana: I'll create the mock with those conditions and link it here when ready. Anyone want to add copy alternatives?

kevin: Minor copy alt: for partial we could say "Partial result — fallback applied" (verb first). Might read clearer when announced.

lee: I like verb-first for screen reader clarity. So: "Partial result — fallback applied".

margo: Great — thanks all. I'll update the Figma and annotate accessibility notes. Will ping when mock is up. :thumbsup:

playground-bot: Updated preview deployed to staging (build #9821).
